jobDetails.title: Data Science Trainee | Data Analyst Trainee | Paid Program
jobDetails.jobDescription:
Data Science

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about building a career in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Data Analytics. This is a paid training program designed to equip fresh graduates and career transition candidates with practical, industry-relevant skills through expert-led sessions, hands-on projects, and real-world case studies.

Upon successful completion of the training program, eligible candidates will receive placement assistance based on their performance, skill development, interview readiness, and employer hiring requirements.

This is a paid training program and not a direct job opportunity. Candidates who successfully complete the program will receive placement assistance based on their performance, technical skills, interview readiness, and employer hiring requirements.

Training Program Includes
  • Python Programming
  • Data Analysis and Visualization
  • SQL and Database Management
  • Machine Learning Fundamentals
  • Artificial Intelligence Concepts
  • Power BI and Dashboard Development
  • Real-Time Projects and Case Studies
  • Career Readiness and Interview Preparation
During the Training, You Will
  • Analyse and interpret datasets.
  • Perform data cleaning and preprocessing.
  • Create reports and interactive dashboards.
  • Build and understand basic machine learning models.
  • Work on real-time project assignments and case studies.
  • Develop practical problem-solving skills using industry tools.
Eligibility
  • BE/BTech, BCA, MCA, BSc, MSc, BCom, MCom, MBA, or equivalent qualification.
  • Fresh graduates and career transition candidates are encouraged to apply.
  • Basic knowledge of programming or data analytics is preferred but not mandatory.
Program Features
  • Industry-focused paid training program.
  • Instructor-led practical learning.
  • Hands-on project experience.
  • Mentorship from experienced industry professionals.
  • Resume building and LinkedIn profile optimisation.
  • Mock technical and HR interview preparation.
  • Placement assistance after successful completion of the training program, subject to candidate performance and employer requirements.
Desired Skills
  • Analytical thinking.
  • Problem-solving ability.
  • Interest in Data Science, AI, and Machine Learning.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills.
  • Willingness to learn and continuously improve.

Location: Bangalore

Program Type: Paid Data Science Training Program

Mode: Offline & Online Training

Placement Support: Available after successful completion of the training program, subject to candidate performance and employer hiring criteria.
